ops.title: Publish terminal wire failure before unblocking a failed send
ops.description: Owner: /root/git_ccn_fetch_source/worktree_root_review. ops.text: Deterministic regression proves terminal transport failure is published before the failed send returns; later single-session calls refuse ErrLaneClosed without replay.
